name: UI：任务管理-编辑弹窗打开与表单验证
description: 点击编辑，验证弹窗打开且表单字段正确渲染

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '编辑'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); const container = modal || drawer; if(!container) return { hasForm: false }; const title = container.querySelector('.ant-modal-title,.ant-drawer-title')?.textContent?.trim(); const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('input, .ant-select, textarea'); const labels = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-label, label')).map(l => l.textContent.trim()); return { hasForm: true, title, inputCount: inputs.length, labels }; })()

steps.description: 验证编辑弹窗/抽屉已打开

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 编辑弹窗应包含任务名称/预期交付时间等表单字段
